paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Tanchum be-Rabbi Chiyya of Kefar Anon: in Midrash Kohelet on ‘A time to give birth’; in Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 6, Kefar Channon. He set out on a ship between Sukkot and Chanukkah. A matron told him not to set sail; his father likewise told him in a dream that he would have no burial either. So it was.
